title: Using Psychology for Pain Relief and Opioid Reduction (SOP67)

sentences.en: Opioids.

sentences.zh: 作为一名疼痛心理学家，您认为媒体关于阿片类药物流行危机的全国性讨论中缺少了什么？

sentences.en: And there's very often news coverage about this topic.
sentences.zh: 关于阿片类药物流行危机？

sentences.en: So as a pain psychologist, what do you think is missing from the national conversation in the media about the opioid epidemic?
sentences.zh: 我觉得心理学在全国性讨论中整合得还不够。

sentences.en: About the opioid epidemic?
sentences.zh: 当然，这种情况正在改变。

sentences.en: I feel that psychology is not integrated enough into the national conversation.
sentences.zh: 关于心理学在疼痛治疗中的作用，以及在预防阿片类药物处方和帮助患者减少阿片类药物使用方面的讨论越来越多。

sentences.en: Granted, that is changing.
sentences.zh: 这确实是我工作的重点。

sentences.en: There has been increasing discussions about the role of psychology in the treatment of pain
sentences.zh: 我正在参与一个国家资助的项目，该项目正在帮助四个州的1300多名慢性疼痛患者减少阿片类药物的使用。

sentences.en: and also in addressing us preventing opioid prescriptions and also helping patients deprescribe their opioids.
sentences.zh: 人们非常关注如何帮助慢性疼痛患者降低健康风险。

sentences.en: And this is really the focus of my work.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，这不仅仅是“用药”或“不用药”的问题。

sentences.en: I am working on a nationally funded project that is helping deprescribe opioids in over 1300 individuals with chronic pain across four states.
sentences.zh: 我们需要超越这种二元对立的讨论，始终回到根本问题上来。

sentences.en: There is intense focus on how do we help people with chronic pain reduce their health risks.
sentences.zh: 我们如何更好地治疗疼痛？

sentences.en: But remember, it's not just opioids or no opioids.
sentences.zh: 当我们专注于这个问题时，心理学必然会脱颖而出。

sentences.en: We need to get beyond that binary conversation and always come back to the fundamental issue.
sentences.zh: 它已经整合到了疼痛的定义中。

sentences.en: How do we help treat pain better?
sentences.zh: 如果不将心理学完全整合到治疗路径中，这个问题就无法解决。

sentences.en: And when we focus on that question, psychology necessarily rises right to the top.
sentences.zh: 我还觉得在这一点上，政策制定者、医生和处方医生已经非常……

sentences.en: It is integrated into the definition of pain.
sentences.zh: 他们对生物医学模型的局限性有了深刻的认识。

sentences.en: It will not be solved without full integration of psychology into treatment pathways.
sentences.zh: 他们现在正在寻求整合。

sentences.en: I also feel that at this point, policymakers, physicians, and prescribers have very...
sentences.zh: 所以这实际上是一个巨大的转变。

sentences.en: They have an acute awareness of the limitations of the biomedical model.
sentences.zh: 现在正是心理学挺身而出，在这个领域发挥领导作用的最佳时机。

sentences.en: And they're now asking for integration.
sentences.zh: 但需要提醒的是，我们确实需要一些政策变革来支持我们挺身而出，

sentences.en: So this is actually a sea change.
sentences.zh: 并帮助解决目前生活在慢性疼痛中的1亿美国人的需求。

sentences.en: And the time is right for psychology to step up and be able to lead in this space.
sentences.zh: 那么您知道这些政策变革会是什么吗？

sentences.en: But the caveat there is that we do need some policy changes to support us in coming forward
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: and helping address the needs of the 100 million Americans that are living with chronic pain right now.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And do you yet know what those policy changes would be?
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: I don't know what the policy changes will be, but I do have ideas about what they should be.
sentences.zh: 我不知道政策会有什么变化，但我确实对政策应该如何制定有一些想法。

sentences.en: So in 2016, my colleagues and I conducted the first national needs assessment for pain psychology access and training in the United States.
sentences.zh: 因此，在2016年，我和同事们在美国进行了首次针对疼痛心理学获取途径和培训的全国性需求评估。

sentences.en: And what we found was that...
sentences.zh: 我们发现的是……

sentences.en: And we surveyed 2,000 key stakeholders across, you know, five or six different groups.
sentences.zh: 我们调查了来自五六个不同群体的2000名关键利益相关者。

sentences.en: And that included over 1,000 individuals living with chronic pain.
sentences.zh: 其中包括1000多名慢性疼痛患者。

sentences.en: It included doctors, nurses, psychologists, directors of psychology training prograMs.
sentences.zh: 还包括医生、护士、心理学家以及心理学培训项目的主管。

sentences.en: It was really a whole host of individuals.
sentences.zh: 确实涵盖了各行各业的人士。

sentences.en: And what we learned was that psychologists and mental health therapists themselves report a lack of education on pain.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到，心理学家和心理健康治疗师自身也反映缺乏关于疼痛的教育。

sentences.en: They're reporting that they recognize that they don't have the training and that they want the training.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，他们意识到自己缺乏相关培训，并且希望获得这些培训。

sentences.en: They need the training.
sentences.zh: 他们需要这些培训。

sentences.en: So we need to better integrate psychology into all levels of education.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们需要将心理学更好地融入各级教育中。

sentences.en: Psychology education at the undergraduate level, the graduate level, the postgraduate level, and also community-based training.
sentences.zh: 包括本科、研究生、博士后阶段的心理学教育，以及社区层面的培训。

sentences.en: So such as at the APA, for instance, you know, having better pain education integrated.
sentences.zh: 例如，在像美国心理学会（APA）这样的机构中，整合更好的疼痛教育。

sentences.en: And this year's conference, of course, has a whole host of trainings on pain.
sentences.zh: 当然，今年的会议也举办了许多关于疼痛的培训。

sentences.en: So this is required in order to better integrate pain and pain education and pain psychology into psychology training prograMs.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了将疼痛、疼痛教育和疼痛心理学更好地融入心理学培训项目，这些都是必要的。

sentences.en: We will need some federal funding streams to support that education.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一些联邦资金渠道来支持这些教育。

sentences.en: No question about it.
sentences.zh: 这一点毋庸置疑。

sentences.en: And then just as a follow-on on that, we really need insurance and payer systems to better support
sentences.zh: 紧接着这一点，我们确实需要保险和支付方系统更好地支持

sentences.en: psychology as primary treatment for pain, to dismantle any existing barriers to psychologists getting reimbursed.
sentences.zh: 将心理学作为疼痛的主要治疗手段，并消除心理学家获得报销的任何现有障碍。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for joining us, Dr. Darnall.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您参加我们的节目，Darnall博士。

sentences.en: Thank you, Caitlin.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，Caitlin。

sentences.en: It's been my pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: It's wonderful having you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Speaking of psychology as part of the APA Podcast Network, which includes other great podcasts
sentences.zh: 说到《Speaking of Psychology》，它是美国心理学会播客网络的一部分，该网络还包括其他优秀的播客，

sentences.en: like APA Journals Dialogue about the latest and most exciting psychological research and progress notes about the practice of psychology.
sentences.zh: 比如探讨最新、最令人兴奋的心理学研究的《APA Journals Dialogue》，以及关于心理学实践的《Progress Notes》。

sentences.en: You can find our podcasts on iTunes, Stitcher, or wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 您可以在iTunes、Stitcher或任何您获取播客的平台上找到我们的节目。

sentences.en: You can also go to speakingofpsychology.org to view more episodes and find resources on the topics we discuss.
sentences.zh: 您也可以访问speakingofpsychology.org查看更多剧集，并查找我们所讨论主题的相关资源。

sentences.en: I'm your host, Caitlin Luna, for the American Psychological Association.
sentences.zh: 我是主持人Caitlin Luna，代表美国心理学会。
